HISD Table

Data tables for structured, comparable information. Each panel shows every state: sunken bold header, zebra rows, a hover wash, a selected (teal) row, sortable column headers driven by aria-sort, a sticky header that pins while the region scrolls, and a focusable role="region" wrapper for horizontal scroll. The right panel is forced to data-theme="dark"; the component inherits dark purely through semantic tokens — no component-specific dark CSS.

Light theme

Sortable · zebra · selected · sticky · scroll region

Click or press Enter / Space on a column header to sort. Click a row, or focus it and press Enter / Space, to select it. The header pins while you scroll; the wide table scrolls horizontally inside the focusable region (Tab to it, then arrow keys scroll).

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Focusable horizontal-scroll region wraps the table (WAI-ARIA region). -->
<div class="hisd-table-region" role="region" aria-label="Campus enrollment" tabindex="0">
  <table class="hisd-table">
    <caption>Campus enrollment 2025&ndash;26</caption>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <!-- Sortable header: <button> in <th>; aria-sort on the <th>. -->
        <th scope="col" aria-sort="ascending">
          <button type="button" class="hisd-table__sort">
            <span class="hisd-table__sort-label">Campus</span>
            <span class="hisd-table__sort-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          </button>
        </th>
        <th scope="col" class="hisd-table__cell--numeric" aria-sort="none">
          <button type="button" class="hisd-table__sort">
            <span class="hisd-table__sort-label">Enrolled</span>
            <span class="hisd-table__sort-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          </button>
        </th>
        <!-- Non-sortable header: plain text, no button, no aria-sort. -->
        <th scope="col">Counselor</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <!-- Zebra striping is automatic. Selected row: aria-selected="true". -->
      <tr tabindex="0" aria-selected="true">
        <th scope="row">Carnegie Vanguard</th>
        <td class="hisd-table__cell--numeric">1,142</td>
        <td>M. Okafor</td>
      </tr>
      <tr tabindex="0">
        <th scope="row">Bellaire High</th>
        <td class="hisd-table__cell--numeric">3,284</td>
        <td>A. Rivera</td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
